source.check: the poll (270, 261, 143) is in the Fermanagh Herald of 28 May 1949, p. 5 ('the election on Wednesday for two Aldermen for the North Ward'); the nominations are in the Belfast News-Letter, 5 May 1949, p. 3 (citation confirmed 7 Nov 2026 from the page images) ('The Nationalists nominated for the North Ward were Messrs. C. M'Keown and John Nethercott (aldermen)')

note: Election of the aldermen of the new Enniskillen Borough Council in 1949: the four Unionist aldermen for the East and South Wards were returned unopposed on 4 May, and the two North Ward aldermen were polled on Wednesday 25 May. The councillors are in the borough's own record (enniskillen-borough-council, 1949); filed apart, as for Belfast and Londonderry (round-2 final, 7 Nov 2026). Poll for the two North Ward aldermen: McKeown 270, Nethercott 261, Bradley 143, with six spoiled papers. The News-Letter's nomination list prints 'John Nethercott'.
